fields.Name: Predictive Studio Gates — Training (statistical)
fields.Description: The six statistical training gates (G2.1, G2.2, G2.3, G2.13, G2.35 at 400 seeds; G2.4 at 60 seeds); each member row's MaxExecutionTimeMS is set from a measured run, and the suite runs and passes once on the final head before merge. Needs MJAPI and the truth sidecar running and `pnpm run truth:provision` done. Run with: MJ_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1 pnpm mj test suite "Predictive Studio Gates — Training (statistical)"
